key_reasoning.reason: One new self-contained build-tool component (Build-image.ps1 + README) added to standalone-build/; no application code or cross-component boundary touched.

No exact PowerShell build-script precedent in this repo, but the pattern (assemble Docker context, invoke engine CLI, capture exit code) is well-established; trivial rollback (delete the script); no app security, performance, or compliance surface.
